fields.description: Issue includes the "NOTEBOOK" column (Wen R. PHILLIPS) commenting on the American Legion convention in Miami and criticizing price increases affecting visitors and residents (lodging, food, and drink), with discussion of local economic conditions and comparisons to nearby areas. Also includes local nightlife and society chatter, extensive racing-related content and tips/advertising ("JOCKEY JIMMY"), and a poem dedicated to Legionnaires ("HAVE YOU SI EN ELMER?"). Masthead and advertising pages provide publication information and local business promotions.
